title: It's not always clear before a 'read/find the true record' action that it will cost standing with a specific companion (e.g. finding the founding ledger via wits at the Hall of Ledgers, or resolving the oath-stone) until the option text is already shown — fine once shown, but the framing 'a hit costs standing' reads oddly (succeeding costs you something) and took a moment to parse.
